title: Emitter machine states
statement: The emitter machine has states for reading a phase; emitting a gate kind and one of three tape indices at a program counter below $64$; printing a word or a bit with the same parameters and a tape index; clearing a tape at one of the three indices; clearing the second scratch tape; and incrementing.
